instructions.base: I'm getting supplies to make these rolls again. I have one of the two things here in mind as a spare: the cutting board or the little prep bowl beside it. Add one product of the kind I mean; the brand, colour and material can differ. Also add one product of each kind I use next: what I use to hold the roll closed, and what I try slicing it into portions with after I've trimmed the ends.

clarification.canonical_answer: The little bowl with the dark mixture in it.
